assets.generation_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original game-development visual reference and compact sprite atlas source
Primary request: A clean 4 by 5 atlas of 20 separate original miniature isometric building sprites for a compact modern city-builder game: house, apartment/shop, power plant with stacks, water treatment tank, fire station, farm with barn and crop rows, materials plant, refinery tanks, import warehouse, defense factory, university, science lab dish, barracks, vehicle factory, drone factory, airbase hangar with runway, SAM radar launcher, missile silo, plus two generic variants. Each sprite is a complete tiny isometric structure with roof planes, front and side walls, gentle pixel-art-style shading, strong silhouettes, and a small soft ground shadow. No text, no labels, no logos, no copied designs. Each item centered in its own evenly-spaced cell and isolated from all others.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background.
Style/medium: original crisp low-detail pixel-art-inspired isometric game sprites, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: uniformly spaced sprite atlas, all structures fully visible, no clipping.
Color palette: cheerful but practical city-builder palette, distinct roof and wall colors.
Constraints: transparent background, no UI, no terrain tiles, no characters, no watermarks, no brand references.
assets.evidence: Exact SHA-256 match to cached generation output; completed generation record and original-art request recovered during the October 2026 review.
